name: openapi-gateway-for-chat
description: Expose remote REST APIs to AI agents in VS Code as native language model tools. Register APIs with OpenAPI 3.0/3.1 specifications via extension commands; the extension registers language model tools (`vscode.lm`) that let Copilot Chat agents and other language model consumers progressively discover and invoke those APIs.

commands.title: OpenAPI Gateway: Register API from URL
OpenAPI Gateway: Register API from File

languageModelTools.name: gateway_list_apis
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists REST APIs registered by the user via the OpenAPI Gateway. Each entry has an apiId you pass to the other gateway_* tools. Start here before calling any API.

languageModelTools.name: gateway_describe_api
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Describes one registered REST API: metadata plus its operation groups (name, description, operation count). Use it to pick relevant groups before listing operations.

apiId.description: Identifier of the API, as returned by gateway_list_apis.

languageModelTools.name: gateway_list_api_operations
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Lists operations of one or more named groups of a registered REST API: operation IDs, methods, paths, summaries, and required parameters.

apiId.description: Identifier of the API, as returned by gateway_list_apis.

groups.description: One or more group names, as returned by gateway_describe_api.

languageModelTools.name: gateway_describe_api_operation
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Describes one operation of a registered REST API in full detail: parameters, request-body schema, and response schemas per status code, with all referenced schemas included inline. Use its output to build a valid gateway_invoke_operation call.

apiId.description: Identifier of the API, as returned by gateway_list_apis.

operationId.description: Operation ID, as returned by gateway_list_api_operations.

languageModelTools.name: gateway_invoke_operation
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Invokes one operation of a registered REST API against its registered base URL. Build the call from gateway_describe_api_operation output: pathParams must supply every required {placeholder} of the path template. Non-safe methods (POST, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, ...) require user confirmation before execution. Errors come back as structured results with status and a body excerpt for retry reasoning.

apiId.description: Identifier of the API, as returned by gateway_list_apis.

operationId.description: Operation ID, as returned by gateway_list_api_operations.

pathParams.description: Values for every {placeholder} in the operation's path template.

queryParams.description: Query parameter values; arrays become repeated keys.

headers.description: Extra request headers; Host, Authorization and Content-Length are reserved.

body.description: Request body. Pass JSON bodies as object or array. Strings are sent verbatim for raw text. Sent only when the operation declares a request body. MUST be object/array for JSON; DO NOT stringify or pass JSON as a string.

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production
scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
